verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party feature page says users can track progress 'using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars', which names all four views in the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, with no in-depth docs or hands-on confirmation of switching between views of the same work. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of view switching over the same dataset, independent or hands-on corroboration, details on calendar/timeline view behavior.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
